studio.title: The studio
studio.description: TRAVER STUDI, an interior design studio founded in Barcelona in 2026. A fresh perspective rooted in Instaltraver’s family history since 1976.
studio.heading: Your space begins with listening.
studio.lead: An interior design studio in Barcelona. A personal approach to every project.
paragraphs: TRAVER STUDI was founded in 2026 with a simple idea: every space begins with the people who live in it. We listen to your needs and shape a distinctive project around the way you want to live.
From the earliest ideas through to the work on site, we help define your project, guide your choice of materials and finishes, and make sure each decision has a clear purpose.
If you are looking for a studio that listens, advises and guides you, you are in the right place.
manifesto: We create a sense of home.

studio.aboutHeading: A fresh perspective. A shared history.
studio.aboutIntro: TRAVER STUDI is a brand of Instaltraver. A new studio with a family history that began in 1976.

timeline.title: Our beginnings
timeline.text: Jorge Traver Bellido and Margarita Hartelsberger Rolón establish Instaltraver in Barcelona. Starting as a neighbourhood plumbing and electrical business, the company soon takes on its first renovation projects.

timeline.title: An eye for interiors
timeline.text: Nadia Traver joins after completing her interior design studies, bringing a new sensitivity to spatial design and the choice of materials and finishes.

timeline.title: Design meets technical expertise
timeline.text: Instaltraver S.L. is established, and Jordi Traver, son of the founders, joins the company. His engineering background strengthens the technical expertise behind its building services work.

timeline.title: TRAVER STUDI is born
timeline.text: After years of renovations increasingly shaped by interior design, TRAVER STUDI is launched as a dedicated studio. It operates alongside Instaltraver, which focuses on building services: two specialisms with a shared history and experience.

services.title: Services
services.description: SOS advice, interior design, complete projects and DELTA kitchen design. Discover how TRAVER STUDI can help with your space.
services.heading: From an idea to your space.
services.lead: Four ways to work together, wherever you are in your project.

items.title: SOS · An expert perspective
items.text: A focused advice session to help you find clarity and make decisions. Whether a renovation is already under way, a layout is not working or you need help choosing finishes, we review the situation with you and offer professional guidance.
details: Review of your questions, plans or photographs.
Guidance on layouts, materials and finishes.
Recommendations to help you take the next step.

items.title: Interior design
items.text: We shape your space around the way you want to live. Starting with your needs, we develop a proposal for the layout, materials, lighting and furniture that brings function and character together.
details: Understanding your needs and the existing space.
Advice on materials, finishes, lighting and furniture.

items.title: The complete project
items.text: We stay with you from the first ideas through to the work on site. Interior design and the technical needs of your project are considered together, so that decisions throughout the renovation follow a shared vision.
details: Development of the interior design project.
Guidance and follow-up during the works.

items.title: DELTA kitchens
items.text: We design your DELTA kitchen around your habits, your space and the way you cook. Layout, storage and finishes come together in a kitchen that is comfortable to use and feels at home within the rest of your interior.
details: Choice of finishes and design advice.

services.scope: We agree the scope and budget with you before work begins.
